asked.item: Is the drop from 60 to 12 credits a glitch after pressing Generate several times on the trial

verdict.reason: The sentences say each Generate click on an image or video spends credits, even when testing, and they say where to check the balance.

steps.text: Each time you click "Generate" on an image or video, credits are spent, even if you're testing.
Credits are only used for AI-generated images and videos.
To check your balance, go to Settings > Billing.
